benign.source: Tranco-style top/trusted domains bundled with the app
benign.description: 380,000 benign/trusted domains used as negative class

phishing.description: 386,613 community-verified phishing domains used as primary positive class

phishing_external_openphish.description: 300 verified phishing URLs (298 valid hostnames after cleaning) used as INDEPENDENT external validation positive class
phishing_external_openphish.role: external validation only (independent, NOT used for training or threshold tuning)

dynamic_feature_data.source: bundled corpus statistics (TLD phishing rates, brands, suspicious TLDs, new gTLDs, keywords)
dynamic_feature_data.purpose: Populates production features 46-52 (brand-in-SLD, TLD phishing rate, new-gTLD, keyword presence)

feature_vector_malware_model.source: Synthetic demonstration model trained by ml/evaluation/train_feature_vector_malware.py on synthetic 68-feature data
feature_vector_malware_model.description: Logistic regression weights (68 features) + bias for FeatureVectorMalwareEngine. SYNTHETIC — NOT production-ready, NOT a claim of real detection performance.
feature_vector_malware_model.role: FeatureVectorMalwareEngine model asset; schema for real Droidware-compatible training
feature_vector_malware_model.note: Train on real Droidware 68-feature data before production use.

splits.grouping: Domain-grouped by registrable domain (registrable_domain = last 2 labels) to prevent related-subdomain leakage across splits
splits.overlap_handling: Exact duplicate domains removed; phishing domains overlapping benign dropped from phishing side

acceptance_targets.honest_disclosure: Best model (LightGBM/HistGradientBoosting) reaches ~0.93 accuracy / ~0.90 recall on held-out sample. 0.95/0.95 NOT met at any useful threshold. Reported honestly, not fabricated.
